value.rationale: The source explicitly uses this small graded algebra as a test object in Yang–Baxter/Nijenhuis deformation theory but supplies only a diagonal operator family. The complete moduli now has three genuinely distinct geometric regimes, a nontrivial quadric-cone component and a common gluing plane, plus sharp arithmetic and invertibility counts for every finite field. These describe the actual deformation-operator parameter space and are not a renaming or a one-parameter substitution.
